document.abstract: The Sypher method of videotape sound post dubbing has now been in use at BBC Television Centre for more than three years. It has been used for processing some 1300 programs of all types and continues to be popular with production and operational staff. This article deals with the origins of the system, its operational functions and the influence it has had on program-making.
